notes: Drop 3 Wave 2: the authored named-hero roster. Heroes ship locked; the engine's recruitment beats (apply_recruitment_beats) activate them when their moment lands. unitDef must be a verified Legion def — act-2 recruits ride the T2 chassis that ARE the player's tech. recruit.type: mission_victory | objective_kind | rep | act_reached.

heroes.name: Rusk Halloway
heroes.fiction: Held the Koom scrap-gate alone for six hours with a jammed gatling and a lie about reinforcements.

heroes.name: Verse Adder
heroes.fiction: Counts her missiles out loud. Has never reached zero without something dying.

heroes.name: Mirren Vex
heroes.fiction: Walks point on every lane the clans have ever taken, and two they officially haven't.

heroes.name: Saint Kettle
heroes.fiction: The Ashwalkers call every rez bot a kettle. This one they call Saint. Nobody stays dead near her if the chassis is honest.

heroes.name: Odessa Krail
heroes.fiction: First of the earned tech: a salvaged amphibious heat-ray hull with a pilot who refuses to dry out.

heroes.name: Brakhov the Kiln
heroes.fiction: Burned his own name off the hull so the enemy would learn it the slow way.

heroes.name: Whisper-of-Ash Yeva
heroes.fiction: The clans are not sure Yeva exists. Armada High Command is sure she doesn't. Both are wrong.

heroes.name: Cauter Bel-Ansa
heroes.fiction: Closes distance like an argument she has already won. The riot cannon is punctuation.

heroes.name: Grath Unpaid
heroes.fiction: A Null Merc line-breaker who has not been paid in three wars. Signs on when the clans' credit finally reads better than the Mercs' ledgers.

heroes.name: Sisu Halq
heroes.fiction: Shoots at map coordinates, not targets. The targets keep being there anyway.

heroes.name: The Last Auditor
heroes.fiction: A T3 all-terrain mech that walked out of a dead Legion vault the day the finale was declared. It keeps its own ledger of what the war still owes.
